topics.title: Stern's Coliseum Frustration
topics.summary: During a live show at the Nassau Coliseum, Howard Stern expresses frustration with logistical issues including expensive video taping and union labor costs. He describes an elaborate setup involving multiple teams of people huddled around screens, leading to confusion about budgets and timelines, ultimately revealing he’d spent $300,000 on the event.

topics.title: Screen Tech and Strange Calls
topics.summary: The broadcast focuses on a new stage setup utilizing video screens, discussing technical aspects like reverse image projection. The conversation abruptly shifts to bizarre calls from Germany involving military commands, mental patients seeking hypnotism, and an unusual obsession with a woman named Celestine Tate.

topics.title: Machete Attacks and Tennis Bets
topics.summary: A Dominican national attacked his girlfriend with a machete while sleeping, then struck another woman and crashed into a police station. Simultaneously, several individuals were placing bets on tennis matches involving robin, including outlandish wagers like betting against her or predicting she’d only hit three balls.”

topics.title: Finger Loss, Drug Charges, Mayor's Race & Political Endorsements
topics.summary: A man loses a finger after an argument about it, followed by discussions of cocaine addiction charges. The Jewish Forward newspaper endorses David Dinkins due to his criticism of Jesse Jackson and support for Israel while Italian-American voters lean towards Rudolph Giuliani over concerns regarding crime. Several endorsements are discussed including the Cardinal's backing of Dinkins.

topics.title: Rocky Graciano’s Health Crisis and Racial Attacks
topics.summary: Radio personality discusses the declining health of Rocky Graciano, who has experienced mental collapse and disorientation following hospitalization. Simultaneously, reports detail recent violent attacks in New York involving racial bias – one targeting a Puerto Rican family with a baby and another against a Black man – prompting concerns about escalating violence.

topics.title: Bizarre Requests & Unconventional Encounters
topics.summary: The conversation details a man’s increasingly strange interactions with multiple women he met at a rock club, including forcing water down their throats and demanding they wear oil-soaked outfits. He recounts bizarre requests like wearing garden hose clothing and being hypnotized, alongside confusing recollections of past relationships.
